dprk-panel-renewal-2024-03-28.dprk-panel-renewal-2024-03-28/public/com: Draft S/2024/255 failed (VOTE) due to Russia's veto, preventing the Panel renewal (MANDATE) until 30 April 2025. Confidential reporting (REPORTING) was rejected; existing sanctions (SCOPE) remain active. The Panel must maintain independence for credible assessments. While the Committee continues work, the proposed terms did not take effect. Analytical suggestion: Secure consensus on extension to ensure uninterrupted fact-based oversight.
dprk-panel-renewal-2024-03-28.dprk-panel-renewal-2024-03-28/JAPAN/comp: Council President Yamazaki, speaking as Japan's representative, stated that Russia's veto forced the Panel of Experts to end operations.
dprk-panel-renewal-2024-03-28.dprk-panel-renewal-2024-03-28/CHINA/comp: China abstained because Russia's views were not fully considered, despite supporting the Panel's independent work and a sanctions time limit with periodic reviews [CHINA].
